blocks.text: 1. Answer Relevancy
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447863941-793303003.png

Faithfulness closed by weighing when its grounding check is worth measuring directly. Answer Relevancy, whether the generated answer actually addresses the question that was asked, checks the other side of the same generation step.
It compares the generated answer against the original query itself, not against the retrieved context.
2. Faithful Versus Relevant Are Two Different Questions
A faithful answer stays grounded in the retrieved context, but can still fail to address what was actually asked.
Answer relevancy checks the other side of that same interaction, the question rather than the source.

blocks.content: {"headers":["Metric","What it compares the answer against"],"rows":[["Faithfulness","The retrieved context"],["Answer relevancy","The original question"]]}

blocks.text: 3. An Answer Can Be Faithful And Irrelevant Together

blocks.alt: An Answer Can Be Faithful And Irrelevant Together
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447863941-573593242.png
Just as faithfulness breaks the answer into individual claims, every claim in an answer can be perfectly grounded in context while still answering the wrong question.
Faithfulness and relevancy are independent, orthogonal failure modes.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.content: An answer that accurately summarizes the retrieved refund policy scores perfect faithfulness even if the user actually asked about shipping speed, since faithfulness never checks the answer against the question at all.

blocks.text: 4. Measuring Relevancy By Semantic Similarity
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447863941-142673551.png
Building on the dense embeddings covered in Embeddings, a common approach embeds the generated answer and the original query, then measures how close they are.
A low similarity score signals the answer likely drifted from what was actually asked.
5. Generating Questions From The Answer
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447863941-480029201.png
Much like Recursive RAG recursively decomposes a query, another approach asks a model to generate questions the answer itself would answer.
Comparing those generated questions back against the original query reveals how closely they match.

blocks.text: 6. A Relevant Answer Can Still Be Wrong

blocks.alt: A Relevant Answer Can Still Be Wrong
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447863942-281799923.png
Just as faithfulness does not check factual accuracy, an answer can directly address the right question and still contain a wrong fact.
Relevancy measures whether the right question was addressed, not whether the answer was correct.
7. Incomplete Answers Score Lower For Relevancy

blocks.alt: Incomplete Answers Score Lower For Relevancy
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447863942-712775054.png
As with the hidden dependency chains covered in Multi-Hop RAG, a multi-part question partially answered scores lower relevancy than one addressed in full.
Relevancy captures completeness of the response relative to what was actually asked.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.content: A question asking for both price and availability scores lower relevancy if the answer only addresses price, even if the price part is perfectly accurate and well grounded.

blocks.text: 8. Faithfulness And Relevancy Together Cover Both Sides
Faithfulness checks the answer against the context, while relevancy checks the answer against the question.
Together they cover both directions a generated answer can go wrong.
9. Recognizing When Answer Relevancy Is Worth Measuring Directly

blocks.alt: Recognizing When Answer Relevancy Is Worth Measuring Directly
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785447863942-152451020.png
A system prone to generating tangential or overly broad answers benefits from tracking relevancy.
A system whose faithfulness scores already look strong, by contrast, still needs relevancy checked separately.

blocks.text: 11. Common Mistakes

items: Assuming a high faithfulness score also means the answer addressed the actual question.
Checking answer relevancy against the retrieved context instead of the original query.
Treating a relevant answer as automatically correct, ignoring whether it is factually accurate.
Scoring a partial answer to a multi-part question the same as a complete one.

blocks.text: 12. Key Takeaways

items: Answer relevancy measures whether the generated answer actually addresses the question asked.
A faithful answer can still fail to address what was actually asked; relevancy checks that separately.
Every claim can be grounded in context while still answering the wrong question.
Semantic similarity between the answer and query embeddings is one common relevancy measure.
Generating questions the answer would answer, then comparing them to the query, is another approach.
A relevant answer can still be factually wrong; relevancy checks the question, not correctness.
A partially answered multi-part question scores lower relevancy than a fully addressed one.
Faithfulness checks the answer against context; relevancy checks it against the question.
